claims.summary: The 0.85 tail-vibrancy onset is a soft gate intended to avoid a latent pop.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete feedback source: the live calculation uses smoothstep with zero endpoint slope, and exact boundary tests pass.

claims.summary: The fixed legacy projection may carry dead columns or collapse into a dominant axis.
claims.disposition: Source-challenged in part: all eight raw norms are finite, normalized columns are near unit length, no dead column is detected, and the weakest column remains far above the near-zero threshold.

claims.summary: The fixed legacy projection may introduce artificial inter-column correlation.
claims.disposition: Verified as a current mechanical issue: 28 pairwise comparisons yield a maximum absolute cosine above 0.15, mean absolute cosine above 0.70, and `columns_weakly_correlated=false`.

claims.summary: A norm-only variance audit is sufficient to clear the fixed projection basis.
claims.disposition: Rejected as insufficient. Norm health rules out dead axes but does not clear the observed basis-wide pairwise correlation or establish semantic phrase separation.

claims.summary: Legacy projection distribution may inadvertently write shadow magnetization or shadow dispersal roles.
claims.disposition: Complete-source challenge finds those roles only as default-off reserved-dimension labels; fixed projection output is confined to dimensions 32-39, and exact gate tests preserve dimensions 44-47.

claims.summary: The correlated fixed basis deserves a replacement-basis comparison.
claims.disposition: Routed to a preregistered, deterministic offline basis-epoch study comparing the compatibility-pinned basis with an orthogonalized candidate on frozen public embeddings.

claims.summary: A healthier candidate basis should replace or rotate the live fixed basis automatically.
claims.disposition: Preserved as an exact Tier 5 wait. Any basis epoch, codec transport, live vector, or deployment change requires captured replay and separate Mike/operator approval.
